note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors. Nominations were received by Mr. John Warden on 26 April 1933. Fourteen divisions were filled unopposed; no nominations were received for Crawfordsburn, Newtownards South and Quintin, whose retiring members held their seats, and Groomsport was contested between Mr. William J. Baillie and Mr. James Mawhinney. Polling in County Down took place on 25 May 1933. Only the fourteen unopposed returns are recorded here. Filed on 1933-05-25, the polling day for county council and rural district elections in Co. Down that year (confirmed); previously filed under 1933-06-01 (verification 5 Nov 2026). Returned unopposed.
